name: The Dandy Warhols tickets
long_description:
Presented by: SBM Presents

The Dandy Warhols return to Australia and New Zealand this November and December for The Dandy Warhols Australia / NZ Tour 2026, in support of their new covers album, Pin Ups. Nearly three decades into their career, the cult alt-rock icons remain one of the most distinctive and adventurous live bands around, blending psych-rock, shoegaze, synth-pop and their trademark swagger.

“Oz tour is right around the corner, and we are getting very pumped about it. This one starts in Tasmania with the Symphony there. That will be a mind, expanding trip. Then we hit all our favorite cities, or most of them, including New Zealand shows. Then we end at Meredith festival, which we are told repeatedly is the coolest. There’s going to be a lot of amazing music, food, wine, and even wineries. We have always loved it down under which is why it’s been The Dandy Warhols second home for almost 3 decades.” - Courtney
